items.title: Chameleon: Exploring Risk Interpretation through Scene-Matched Textures in Virtual Reality
items.snippet: Users in virtual reality need to judge contact risks around physical objects while remaining engaged in the virtual scene. Scene-matched textures give physical objects a place in virtual reality and provide visual cues for interaction. We examine how Chameleon's risk-aware textures are perceived during a reaching task. A study with 42 participants compared scanned appearances with red warnings, uniform environment textures, and risk-aware scene-matched textures. Participants rated the risk-aware condition more favorably on four aspects of perceived cue clarity than both alternatives. Interview
items.summary: VR内で物理オブジェクトの接触リスクを判断するために、シーンにマッチしたテクスチャが重要だにゃ。研究では、42人の参加者がリスク認識テクスチャを評価し、他の条件よりも明確さが高いと感じたそうだにゃ。これにより、VR体験の向上が期待されているにゃん。
